answer: Sybil resistance arises because each identity is bonded to an escrow whose slash is linked to correlated behavior: if k identities equivocate together, the penalty grows as O(k²), while detection applies an exponential capital-loss multiplier to the controlling stake, including asymmetric depreciation of remaining collateral. Thus a wharf, comet, or tundra of aliases cannot cheaply amplify influence: coordination makes the swarm progressively more expensive to operate and recover.
